arxiv-2001-03739.title: Quantifying Residual Motion Artifacts in Fetal fMRI Data
arxiv-2001-03739.creator: Athena Taymourtash, Ernst Schwartz, Karl-Heinz Nenning, Daniel Sobotka, Mariana Diogo, Gregor Kasprian, Daniela Prayer, Georg Langs
arxiv-2001-03739.description: Abstract Fetal functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) has emerged as a powerful tool for investigating brain development in utero, holding promise for generating developmental disease biomarkers and supporting prenatal diagnosis. However, to date its clinical applications have been limited by unpredictable fetal and maternal motion during image acquisition.

arxiv-2105-07051.title: A pivoting Mechanically Controllable Break junction setup enabling “partially wet phase” MCB-junctions.
arxiv-2105-07051.creator: C.J. Muller
arxiv-2105-07051.description: Abstract A technique is presented, which creates MCB junctions that can be pivoted to any desirable angle. The MCB junction equipped with a specific glass liquid cell can be used to produce a MCB junction, of which the electrodes are covered with a microscopic layer of fluid, thus producing a “partially wet phase” MCB junction.

arxiv-2202-03059.title: Evaluation of Runtime Monitoring for UAV Emergency Landing
arxiv-2202-03059.creator: Joris Guerin, Kevin Delmas, Jérémie Guiochet
arxiv-2202-03059.description: Abstract To certify UAV operations in populated areas, risk mitigation strategies – such as Emergency Landing (EL) – must be in place to account for potential failures. EL aims at reducing ground risk by finding safe landing areas using on-board sensors.

arxiv-2209-11778.title: Formation History of HD106906 and the Vertical Warping of Debris Disks by an External Inclined Companion
arxiv-2209-11778.creator: Nathaniel W. H. Moore, Gongjie Li, Lee Hassenzahl, Erika R. Nesvold, Smadar Naoz, Fred C. Adams
arxiv-2209-11778.description: Abstract HD106906 is a planetary system that hosts a wide-orbit companion, as well as an eccentric and flat debris disk, which hold important constraints on its formation and subsequent evolution. The recent observations of the companion constrain its orbit to be eccentric and inclined relative to the plane of the debris disk.

arxiv-2306-14652.title: Strongly coupled fermions in odd dimensions and the running cut-off Λ d \Lambda_{d}
arxiv-2306-14652.creator: Evangelos G. Filothodoros 1
arxiv-2306-14652.description: Abstract I study the fermionic U ⁡ ( N ) U(N) Gross-Neveu model at imaginary chemical potential and finite temperature for odd d d dimensions, in the strong coupling regime, by using the gap (saddle point) equation for the fermion condensate of the model. This equation describes the phase transitions from weak to strong coupling regime.

arxiv-2307-01729.title: Mechanism for sound dissipation in a two-dimensional degenerate Fermi gas
arxiv-2307-01729.creator: Krzysztof Gawryluk, Mirosław Brewczyk
arxiv-2307-01729.description: Abstract We numerically study the transport properties of a two-dimensional Fermi gas in a weakly and strongly interacting regimes, in the range of temperatures close to the transition to a superfluid phase. For that we excite sound waves in a fermionic mixture by using the phase imprinting technique, follow their evolution, and finally determine both their speed and attenuation.

arxiv-2311-08644.title: Wrapper Boxes: Faithful Attribution of Model Predictions to Training Data
arxiv-2311-08644.creator: Yiheng Su, Junyi Jessy Li, Matthew Lease
arxiv-2311-08644.description: Abstract Can we preserve the accuracy of neural models while also providing faithful explanations of model decisions to training data? We propose a “wrapper box” pipeline: training a neural model as usual and then using its learned feature representation in classic, interpretable models to perform prediction.

arxiv-2405-07678.title: Relativistic Roots of κ \kappa -Entropy
arxiv-2405-07678.creator: G. Kaniadakis
arxiv-2405-07678.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by G. Kaniadakis. The axiomatic structure of the κ \kappa -statistcal theory is proven. In addition to the first three standard Khinchin–Shannon axioms of continuity, maximality, and expansibility, two further axioms are identified, namely the self-duality axiom and the scaling axiom. It is shown that both the κ \kappa -entropy and its special limiting case, the classical Boltzmann–Gibbs–Shannon entropy, follow unambiguously from the above new set of five axioms.

arxiv-2408-13317.title: Benchmarking the performance of a high-Q cavity qudit using random unitaries
arxiv-2408-13317.creator: M. Sohaib Alam
arxiv-2408-13317.description: Abstract High-coherence cavity resonators are excellent resources for encoding quantum information in higher-dimensional Hilbert spaces, moving beyond traditional qubit-based platforms. A natural strategy is to use the Fock basis to encode information in qudits. One can perform quantum operations on the cavity mode qudit by coupling the system to a non-linear ancillary transmon qubit.

arxiv-2505-21136.title: SageAttention2++: A More Efficient Implementation of SageAttention2
arxiv-2505-21136.creator: Jintao Zhang, Xiaoming Xu, Jia Wei, Haofeng Huang, Pengle Zhang, Chendong Xiang, Jun Zhu, Jianfei Chen
arxiv-2505-21136.description: Abstract The efficiency of attention is critical because its time complexity grows quadratically with sequence length. SageAttention2 addresses this by using quantization to speed up matrix multiplications (Matmul) in attention. To further accelerate SageAttention2, we propose to utilize the faster instruction of FP8 Matmul accumulated in FP16.

arxiv-2507-13885.title: Quantum Pattern Matching with Wildcards
arxiv-2507-13885.creator: Masoud Seddighin, Saeed Seddighin
arxiv-2507-13885.description: Abstract Pattern matching is one of the fundamental problems in Computer Science. Both the classic version of the problem as well as the more sophisticated version where wildcards can also appear in the input can be solved in almost linear time O ~ ​ ( n ) \tilde{O}(n) using the KMP algorithm and Fast Fourier Transform, respectively.

pmc-11464578.creator: Georg Sterniste, Klaus Hackner, Florentine Moazedi-Fürst, Marie Grasl, Marco Idzko, Guangyu Shao, Claudia Guttmann-Ducke, Emina Talakić, Helmut Prosch, Sylvia Lohfink-Schumm, Michael Gabriel, Clarice Lim, Johann Hochreiter, Brigitte Bucher, Barbara C Böckle, Hans Peter Kiener, Christina Duftner, Kas
pmc-11464578.description: Die Sarkoidose ist in vielen Fällen eine Multisystemerkrankung, die eine interdisziplinäre medizinische Zusammenarbeit in Diagnostik, Therapie und in der medizinischen Betreuung im Verlauf erfordert. Aufgrund des oft chronischen Verlaufes ist es besonders wichtig, Patientinnen und Patienten mit ihren Prioritäten und Wünschen frühzeitig und umfassend in die medizinische Betreuung einzubinden und, wenn möglich, ein „shared decision making“ zu etablieren.
